measures.name: Displayed_SKU
measures.expression:
VAR DefVal = [Def_Slicer_Val]
VAR Barcode_Scan = 'BarcodeTable'[ScannedBarcode]
VAR DisplayedSKU = COALESCE(SELECTEDVALUE('SalesSKUs'[Product]),

CALCULATE(FIRSTNONBLANK('SalesSKUs'[Product],'AA_MEASURE_TABLE'[Def_Slicer_Val]),ALLEXCEPT('SalesSKUs','SalesSKUs'[LOC_CODE],'SalesSKUs'[Stock_Dept]),SalesSKUs[BARCODE]=Barcode_Scan),DefVal)

RETURN DisplayedSKU

measures.name: Disp_SKU_Status

VAR SKUStatus = 
    CALCULATE(
        FIRSTNONBLANK('SalesSKUs'[Stock_SKUStatus], 'AA_MEASURE_TABLE'[Def_Slicer_Val]),
        ALLEXCEPT('SalesSKUs', 'SalesSKUs'[LOC_CODE], 'SalesSKUs'[Stock_Dept]),
        SalesSKUs[Product] = DisplayedSKU
    )

RETURN
    IF(ISBLANK(SKUStatus), "NA", SKUStatus)

measures.name: SALES_CONRTIBUTION
measures.expression:
VAR SKU_SALES=SUM(REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[SALES_VALUE_LAST_1MONTH])
VAR CurrentCategory = SELECTEDVALUE(REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[CATEGORY_NAME])
VAR CAT_SALES=CALCULATE(SUM(REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[SALES_VALUE_LAST_1MONTH]),REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[CATEGORY_NAME]=CurrentCategory,ALL(REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[SKU]),ALL(BARCODES[BARCODE]))
RETURN DIVIDE(SKU_SALES,CAT_SALES)

measures.name: CAT_SALES
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentCategory = SELECTEDVALUE(REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[CATEGORY_NAME])
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Sales],
        REMOVEFILTERS(REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[SKU]), // Clears SKU filter
        REMOVEFILTERS(BARCODES[BARCODE]), // Clears barcode filter if applicable
        REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[CATEGORY_NAME] = CurrentCategory // Keeps category filter
    )

measures.name: SKU_RANK_IN_CATEGORY_V2_FINAL
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentCategory = SELECTEDVALUE(REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[CATEGORY_NAME])
VAR CurrentSKU = SELECTEDVALUE(REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[SKU])

VAR CategorySKUs = 
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[SKU]),
        REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[CATEGORY_NAME] = CurrentCategory,
        ALL(REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3),ALL(BARCODES)
    )

RETURN
IF(
    NOT ISBLANK(CurrentCategory) && NOT ISBLANK(CurrentSKU),
    RANKX(
        CategorySKUs,
        CALCULATE(
            SUM(REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[SALES_VALUE_LAST_1MONTH]),
            ALLEXCEPT(
                REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3,
                REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[SKU],
                REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[CATEGORY_NAME],
                REP_SSR_STOCK_STATUS_REPORTV3[LOC_CODE]

            )
        ),
        ,
        DESC,
        DENSE
    )
)

measures.name: Top 5 Sales Dates Fixed
measures.expression:
VAR SelectedSKU = SELECTEDVALUE(SKU_DAY_SALES[sku])
RETURN
TOPN(
    5,
    SUMMARIZE(
        FILTER(SKU_DAY_SALES, SKU_DAY_SALES[sku]= SelectedSKU),
        SKU_DAY_SALES[doc_date],
        "Total Sales",SUM(SKU_DAY_SALES[sales_quantity]) -- If you have timestamp
    ),
    [Total Sales], DESC,
    SKU_DAY_SALES[doc_date], DESC  -- Break ties by most recent entry
)

measures.name: Top 5 Ranked
measures.expression:
VAR SelectedSKU = SELECTEDVALUE(SKU_DAY_SALES[sku])
VAR DailySales =
    SUMMARIZE(
        FILTER(
            SKU_DAY_SALES,
            SKU_DAY_SALES[sku] = SelectedSKU
        ),
        SKU_DAY_SALES[doc_date],
        "TotalSales", SUM(SKU_DAY_SALES[sales_quantity])
    )
VAR RankedSales =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        DailySales,
        "Rank", RANKX(
            DailySales,
            [TotalSales] * 10000 + YEAR(SKU_DAY_SALES[doc_date]) * 100 + MONTH(SKU_DAY_SALES[doc_date]),
            ,
            DESC,
            Dense
        )
    )
RETURN
FILTER(RankedSales, [Rank] <= 5)
